_meta.note: Structural regression golden. Switched from local 529-only withRetry to callClaudeWithRetry (parse-retry + truncation fail-fast). 9 — one sentence annotations stripped from primary output (comeback line/technique/delivery_note + nuclear/high-road lines) — check:golden checks STRUCTURE not content, eyeball wording after prompt edits. Guard on top-level comebacks[] array. Re-locked 2026-08-23 (v2): the output was explaining the social dynamics instead of handing over five good lines. situation_read is GONE — it invented motive ("ghosted the conversation") and consequence ("you would look defensive") from an input that said only that the peer moved on. technique and why_it_works are gone from each comeback: naming the device is the trick explained next to the trick. the_high_road.why_its_devastating became why — one sentence about the LINE, no predictions about what anyone watching concludes. The nuclear warning is one light line ("Funny to imagine, better left imagined") rather than a lecture about burning relationships. delivery_note is now optional and usually null. Added the shared supplied-facts check (backend/lib/factCheck.js) over the comeback lines and the high road — comebacks were inventing the visitor's own history ("my next eight years of doing this"). the_nuclear_option.line is deliberately EXEMPT from that check: it is the fantasy drawer, the schema already requires a bracketed placeholder instead of invented ammunition, and checking it turns the one line allowed to be too far into the tamest thing on the page. Adopted PF-39 v2 at this lock.

input.situation: In a team meeting, a coworker took credit for my project idea in front of our boss
input.whatTheySaid: Yeah, I came up with this approach last week

comebacks.line: Interesting — I actually sent you that idea [when/how you communicated it]. Want me to forward it?
You know what, that's fair. I'll start putting my name on the drafts I send you.
comebacks.delivery_note: Delivered so pleasantly it takes a second to land.

comebacks.line: That was the idea I pitched to you [timeframe]. But I'm glad it landed with the boss.
I appreciate the confidence in the approach. I'll make sure the documentation reflects who developed it.
That's the one I walked you through, yeah. Good instincts recognizing it was solid.
comebacks.delivery_note: Said with genuine cheer, as if complimenting their taste.

the_high_road.line: I'll follow up with you and [boss] on the timeline so there's no confusion going forward.
the_high_road.why: It names the problem without accusing anyone and moves straight to solving it — nothing to defend, nothing to argue about.

the_nuclear_option.line: That's wild because [the original timestamp/medium where you presented it] begs to differ.
the_nuclear_option.warning: Satisfying to imagine. Probably better left there.

input.situation: In einem Team-Meeting nahm ein Kollege vor unserem Chef die Anerkennung für meine Projektidee
input.whatTheySaid: Ja, ich habe diesen Ansatz letzte Woche entwickelt

comebacks.line: Interessant – ich bin mir sicher, dass ich diese Idee [zeitpunkt] entwickelt habe.
comebacks.delivery_note: Ruhig, als würde man eine Tatsache feststellen, die jedem im Raum gerade eingefallen ist.

comebacks.line: Das freut mich, dass dir der Ansatz so gut gefällt.
Letzte Woche? Ich habe das Konzept [wann] skizziert – vielleicht verwechselst du das mit meinem Input.
Du hast recht, es war letzte Woche – nachdem ich es dir vorgestellt habe.
comebacks.delivery_note: Mit einem ruhigen Nicken, als würde man dem Chef einen kleinen Gedankenfehler helfen zu korrigieren.

comebacks.line: Dann freut mich, dass die Idee direkt so gut bei dir angekommen ist.
comebacks.delivery_note: Tonlos freundlich – so neutral, dass jeder hört, dass hier etwas nicht stimmt.

the_high_road.line: Danke der Klarstellung – ich hätte die Eigenart meiner eigenen Idee fast übersehen.
the_high_road.why: Es benennt die Absurdität direkt, ohne Vorwürfe zu machen, und bleibt dabei sachlich.

the_nuclear_option.line: Beeindruckend, wie schnell du von der Erklärung zur vollständigen Urheberschaft übergegangen bist – das sollte man timen.
the_nuclear_option.warning: Zu direkt, zu sichtbar aggressiv – aber manchmal braucht man das, um sich besser zu fühlen.
